paite: Huchih lai in Baptispa Johan in,
heading: Baptispa Johan Thugen / (Mar 1.1-8; Luk 3.1-18; Joh 1.19-28)

paite: "Kisik un! Van-gam anaita," chi in Judia gamdai ah thu gen in ahong pai hi.
Amah ahi, zawlnei Isai in: "Gamdai a mi kikou aw in, Toupa lamlian sial unla, alampite tangsak un, achi," chi a ana gen pen.
Johan in sangawngsau mul puan asilh a, savun kawnggak agak a, a-an khaukhup leh khuaizu ahi.
Huchih lai in Jerusalem khua, Judia gam tengteng, Jordan luidung kim tengteng akiang ah ahong paikhawm ua,
akhelhna uh thupha tawi in, Jordan lui ah baptisma atang uhi.
Himahleh Pharisaite leh Saddukaite tampi ama a baptisma tang ding a hong paite amuh in, akiang uah, "Nou gul suante! Thangpaihna hong tung ding taisan ding a kua'n hon thuhilh ahia?
Huchi in kisikna toh kilawm gah hon suangkhia un.
Abraham ka pu uh ahi, chi in kingaihtuah kei un, Pathian in hiai suangte Abraham suante in adingsak thei ka hon chi ahi.
Tu a kipan in singbul teng ah heipi akoihta uh; huchi in sing chih gah hoih a gah lou peuhpeuh aphuk ua, mei ah apailut zel uhi.

Ke'n zaw kisikna ding in tui in ka hon baptis a, himahleh, amah ka nung a hong pai kei sang in athupizaw a, akhedap tawitak leng ka hi kei, ama'n zaw Kha Siangthou leh mei in noute ahon baptis ding hi.
Akhut in phazah atawi a, aphual azapsiang sipsip ding a, buhpang ah abuh asung ding, asi bel mei mit thei lou in ahalmang ding,” achi hi.
Huchih lai in akiang a baptisma tang ding in Galili gam a kipan Jordan lui ah Johan kiang ah Jesu ahong pai hi.
heading: Jesu Baptisna / (Mar 1.9-11; Luk 3.21-22)

paite: Johan in, "Nang kei na hon baptis kiphamohzaw hinapi, ka kiang ah na hong zosop ahi maw?" chi in akham hi.
Himahleh Jesu'n akiang ah, "Tu in lemsa teitei in, hichibang a diktatna tengteng hihtangtun ei a ding in akilawm ngal a," chi in adawng a, huchi in lem asata hi.
Huan Jesu baptisma atantak in tui a kipan apawt pah a, ngai in, amah a ding in van ahong kihong a, Pathian Kha, vakhu bang a hong suk in, atung a hong tu amu hi.
Huan ngai in, van a kipan aw in, "Hiai ka Tapa deihtak, ka kipahna mahmah ahi," achi hi.
